deterministic_contract: Render the product-specific prompt_json and send it to built-in ChatGPT image generation with inspected local references. QA uses the same executable layout.
legacy_namespace_note: Directory and IDs retained for stable references; no Higgsfield dependency.

renderer_contract.dimension_policy: 3:4 PDP and separate 1:1 square; save native originals and record actual dimensions

gmc_feed_contract.crop_rule: Do not crop the 3:4 PDP master when that would cut any part of the model or garment; render an independent full-body square composition.

file_hash_rule: SHA-256 over each referenced file's exact UTF-8 bytes
executable_templates_hash_rule: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON without a trailing newline (sorted object keys, compact separators) of an array of {json_path, sha256} records in slot_order
canonical_hash_rule: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON without a trailing newline (sorted object keys, compact separators) of this document with pack_sha256 omitted
gallery_order_note: Stable template IDs are retained: 01b is display position 2; old templates 02–06 occupy positions 3–7. Built-in ChatGPT image generation overrides legacy provider metadata.

runtime_override_2026_09_13.transport: Use the available built-in image tool with rendered prompt_json and inspected reference images. Legacy provider/command/resolution fields are historical composition metadata, not executable transport requirements.
runtime_override_2026_09_13.dimensions: 3:4 PDP, separate 1:1 GMC rendition; record actual native dimensions; no guaranteed 4K tier.
runtime_override_2026_09_13.review: Internal QA for every generated image; upload accepted originals directly to the owned Shopify DRAFT without image, colour-front, gallery or upload approval pauses. Final human review before activation.
runtime_override_2026_09_13.gallery: 7 PDP shots per selected colour; square excluded.

maintenance_note: 2026-09-16: removed obsolete runtime/approval instructions; aligned duplicated layout metadata to executable prompts; fixed second-model reference semantics. Prior versions retained outside installable skill.
approval_update_2026_09_15: Ilias removed all intermediate image, colour-front, gallery and upload approval pauses. Internal QA precedes direct DRAFT upload. Final human review precedes activation; no human image approval is implied.

missing_view_update_2026_09_15.instruction: Even if a view is not available in the competitor page, generate it using the reference images available.
missing_view_update_2026_09_15.scope: All gallery views; no extra missing-view approval. Preserve known garment facts, infer unseen geometry conservatively and document inference. Internal QA precedes direct DRAFT upload.
